name: Window Sticker
author: Helmut Januschka
description: Pin a labelled sticker (banner, flag, wax seal, washi tape, luggage tag) to any Hyprland window. Super+Shift+R to compose, auto-sticker by class/title rules, overview of stickered windows, optional bar widget.

barWidget.description: Count of stickered windows; click for the overview.
